relations.subject: Richard Dudley Baker
relations.evidence: beginning to sit with Shunryu Suzuki in 1961. Baker was ordained a Sōtō priest by Suzuki in 1966... Baker received Dharma transmission from Suzuki in 1970

relations.subject: Richard Dudley Baker
relations.evidence: a scholarship allowed him to attend Harvard University, where he studied architecture and history.

relations.subject: Richard Dudley Baker
relations.evidence: Baker assumed abbotship of the San Francisco Zen Center (SFZC) shortly before Suzuki's death in 1971. He remained abbot there until 1984

relations.subject: Richard Dudley Baker
relations.evidence: Following his departure from the San Francisco Zen Center in 1984... He relocated to Santa Fe, New Mexico where he founded a new community known as Dharma Sangha.

relations.subject: Tenshin Reb Anderson
relations.evidence: In 1983 Tenshin Reb Anderson received shiho (Dharma Transmission) from Richard Baker.

relations.subject: Tenshin Reb Anderson
relations.evidence: Anderson succeeded him as abbot, and later co-abbot.

relations.subject: Issan Dorsey
relations.evidence: In the late-1980s Baker also gave shiho to Issan Dorsey, whom he had ordained as a priest in 1975.

relations.subject: Philip Whalen
relations.evidence: the poet Philip Whalen, who Baker had ordained as a priest in 1973... In July 1987 Baker gave Dharma transmission to Whalen

relations.subject: Nicole Baden
relations.evidence: Together with his longtime disciple and chosen successor, Tatsudo Nicole Baden Roshi

relations.subject: Nicole Baden
relations.evidence: Both his resignation and Baden’s instalment as Dharma Sangha’s new abbot happened during a formal Mountain Seat Ceremony.

relations.subject: Dan Welch
relations.evidence: Richard Baker has given dharma transmission in the lineage of Shunryu Suzuki to eleven disciples, thus authorizing them as independent teachers. They are: Reb Anderson, Issan Dorsey, Philip Whalen, Dan Welch, Paul Rosenblum, Rocio Maria Hernández Pozo, Gerald Weischede, Ottmar Engel, David Beck, Christian Dillo, and Nicole Baden.
